prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: whole spices hitting hot oil and exploding into fragrance — mustard seeds popping and jumping out of the pan like popcorn in macro. Onion and tomato collapse in, turning deep amber. Chickpeas cascade into the simmering base in a golden waterfall. Money shot: coconut milk poured in a slow white spiral that marbles through the red curry hypnotically before being folded in, spinach leaves wilting emerald into it, steam rolling backlit. Final beat: the curry ladled generously over steaming rice, cilantro falling in slow motion. Warm dramatic light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the seed pops, then the thick simmer blub. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
